title: Hosted GitHub Artifact to Browser Exact-Byte SHA-256 Parity
requirements: Require actual distinct hosted and browser-delivered artifact byte streams
Match both exact byte strings and exact SHA-256 to an explicitly pinned expected digest
Bind claimed GitHub run ID, source commit and artifact name to the same inventory ancestry
Keep the nested deterministic local evidence ZIP distinct from GitHub-hosted upload-artifact ZIP
Do not accept own-site reference pins as independent custody or proof of external retention
Reject missing bytes, unpinned expected digest, substituted runs and stale or expired artifact records
Never treat synthetic regression passes as independently confirmed native CI execution
Browser comparison must not upload or transmit the selected evidence bytes
limitations: Public hosted Actions ZIP download was not available from current tools and no genuine archive digest could be verified
The source-owned reference is intentionally unpinned and fails closed; users must obtain authentic expected digest independently
CI workflow runs offline synthetic tests and records missing evidence but cannot self-authenticate its hosted archive
No independently authenticated original hardware capture or external custodian available
